retained_candidates.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Vitruvius lamp test: failed air observation changes the permitted descent and triggers ventilation
retained_candidates.source: Vitruvius VIII.6.12–13, Morgan1914 translation, complete cached paragraphs746–747 in the bounded HTML paragraph extraction.
retained_candidates.condition_action_result: Lower lighted lamp; continued burning licenses human descent; extinction calls for shafts; completed shafts carry vapours off. The lamp, person and environment are distinct owners.
retained_candidates.computed_consequence: Burning observation entails descent permission, not achieved bodily treatment. Extinction entails prescribed shaft construction; the environmental result belongs to the shafts. There is no explicit repeated lamp test after intervention.
retained_candidates.minimal_target_binding_plan: Prospectively freeze a finite observation/permission/intervention constructor with written lamp/test-object, human actor, well environment, condition scope, and state succession. Reuse these participants through one complete admitted exposed unit. C0 bindings may be hypothesized and charged; no basin-to-well or fire-to-lamp identity from proximity.
retained_candidates.smallest_falsifier: A fully licensed target continuation under the unchanged constructor transfers the lamp outcome directly to a patient-treatment result, asserts descent under the failed observation without the written intervention branch, or swaps observation and prescribed action while preserving the same owner/state. Unbound participants or force give NO_CAPACITY.
retained_candidates.decision_change: An independently fixed source packet plus finite binding can compare an observational permission constructor with direct treatment or descriptive-state constructions; currently retain raw, no target trial.

retained_candidates.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Vitruvius lime: prior burning changes later binding while the treated material persists
retained_candidates.source: Vitruvius II.5.1–3, Morgan1914 translation, complete cached paragraphs128–130.
retained_candidates.condition_action_result: Unburned limestone merely crushed and mixed does not cohere; kiln treatment changes the continuing material, then water contact and sand mixture yield cohesion while drying. Bulk persists while weight decreases.
retained_candidates.computed_consequence: Deleting prior BURN while retaining a raw crushing/mixing branch changes the historical cohesion output from solidification to failure. A ratio-only or grinding-only function cannot preserve the explicit negative branch. One material retaining bulk but losing weight must not become two independent object values.
retained_candidates.minimal_target_binding_plan: Prospectively freeze one material reference and a finite preparation-history argument consumed by later mixing/result predicates, with distinct weight/bulk fields. Carry the history through a complete admitted exposed unit; shared composition must compute the result instead of storing an independent meaning for each prepared whole.
retained_candidates.smallest_falsifier: A fully licensed unchanged raw-grinding branch is assigned the treated cohesion result, or a later result ignores the stipulated required burning history. Unknown branch, time or material identity remains UNBOUND. Do not infer universal modern chemistry from this historical account.
retained_candidates.decision_change: If an actual target chain reuses this finite history argument, compare a history-dependent constructor against an otherwise fixed immediate-operation/ratio-only constructor. Without written recurrence and branch ownership this remains a source hypothesis.
predecessors: IDEA000458: II.4 sand sample suitability; it excludes II.5 prior limestone treatment

retained_candidates.title: Cato De Agri Cultura 133 attached layering and basket transplant constructor
retained_candidates.source: Cato133 whole chapter and source ambiguities preserved in GDT1001; public Loeb translation, not identified medieval Vorlage. No new source-body acquisition here.
retained_candidates.condition_action_result: A continuing propagule roots while attached, then is cut and transplanted; the basket can persist into planting. Vine versus other branch changes the stated waiting age, with ambiguous antecedents retained.
retained_candidates.computed_consequence: Moving detachment before rooting removes the on-tree attached/rooting state. Replacing the construction with graft fusion merges identities, losing the continuing detached rooted shoot and its container. Neither follows merely from the same plant names.
retained_candidates.minimal_target_binding_plan: Freeze persistent parent/propagule/container identities, explicit attachment and root state, age branch, cut boundary and subsequent planting. A C0 finite state/argument constructor must be reused within one whole admitted exposed unit, not supplied as a new per-word whole dictionary.
retained_candidates.smallest_falsifier: A licensed target uses the still-attached rooted propagule as an already detached planted individual before the declared cut, or merges parent/propagule while retaining the unchanged layering contract. Unknown chronology or source antecedent cannot count as failure.
retained_candidates.decision_change: Only a materially different attachment/state consequence could reopen cultivation exploration. It does not reopen the exact GDT1001 code route; no ready target binding currently exists.
